files.text:
Booking confirmation
Casa da Ribeira, Rua de São João 12, 4050-552 Porto
Confirmation number 88213-RB. Thank you for staying with us.
Your stay
Three nights, from Sunday 14 June to Wednesday 17 June 2026. One double room with a river
view, for two guests. Breakfast is included and served from 07:30 to 10:30 in the courtyard.
Arriving
Check-in is from 15:00 and check-out is by 11:00. If you arrive early, we are happy to keep your
luggage at reception. The hotel is a ten-minute taxi ride from Porto Campanhã station.
Payment
EUR 435.00 for the stay, paid in advance. The city tourist tax of EUR 2 per person per night is
paid at the hotel.
Cancellation
Free cancellation until 7 June 2026. After that date the first night is charged.

files.name: Itinerary - Lisbon and Porto.md
files.text:
# Lisbon and Porto, June 2026

## Thursday 11 June · Lisbon
Land at 14:10. Metro to Baixa-Chiado and drop the bags at the apartment.
Evening walk through Alfama, dinner near the castle.

## Friday 12 June · Lisbon
Tram 28 in the morning, before the queues.
Afternoon in Belém: the tower, the monastery, pastries.
Sunset from the viewpoint at Senhora do Monte.

## Saturday 13 June · Lisbon
Market at Campo de Ourique for lunch. Free afternoon.

## Sunday 14 June · Train to Porto
08:39 from Santa Apolónia, tickets on the phone. Hotel check-in from 15:00.

## Monday 15 June · Porto
Boat trip under the six bridges, then the port cellars in Gaia.

## Tuesday 16 June · Porto
Bolhão market, bookshop, walk along the river at night.

files.name: Packing list.md
files.text:
# Packing list

- Passports and the printed hotel booking
- Comfortable walking shoes for the hills
- Light jacket for the evenings by the river
- Sunglasses and sunscreen
- Travel adapter (type F)
- Camera, spare battery and the external drive
- Reusable water bottle

files.name: Places to eat.txt
files.text:
Places to eat

Lisbon
- Custard tarts warm from the oven, near Largo do Camões. Go early.
- Grilled sardines in Alfama, any small place with tables outside.
- Time Out Market for a quick lunch if it rains.

Porto
- Francesinha at a café near the station. Huge, share one.
- Fresh fruit and cheese from Bolhão market for a picnic by the river.
- Coffee and a pastry at the old café on Rua de Santa Catarina.
